Notes.Name: Quick and Easy Day of the Week Date Picker
Notes.Details: This snippet will return the days of the current week, and display the results using the Out-GridView for you to select the date you want.

Notes.Name: Convert From WMI Datetime
Notes.Details: When using the Get-WmiObject cmdlet datetimes are returned using the Common Information Model (CIM) format. This command will convert these to standard datetime objects.

Notes.Name: First Weekday of Month
Notes.Snippet:
# Get first day of Month
$FirstWeekDay = Get-Date $date.Date -day 1
# if day is Sat or Sun add days until it is not
while(0,6 -contains $FirstWeekDay.DayOfWeek.value__){
    $FirstWeekDay = $FirstWeekDay.AddDays(1)
}
$FirstWeekDay
Notes.Details: Returns the first weekday of the month for any given date.

Notes.Name: Last Weekday of Month
Notes.Snippet:
# Get last day of Month
$LastWeekDay = (Get-Date $date.Date -day 1).AddMonths(1).AddMilliseconds(-1)
# if day is Sat or Sun subtract days until it is not
while(0,6 -contains $LastWeekDay.DayOfWeek.value__){
    $LastWeekDay = $LastWeekDay.AddDays(-1)
}
$LastWeekDay
Notes.Details: Returns the last weekday of the month for any given date.
